academicYears.settingsSubtitle: Create, prepare, and activate academic years
academicYears.createTitle: Set up a new academic year
academicYears.createDescription: Start with a clean year or selectively bring forward setup data from a previous year. Grades and historical activity are never copied.
academicYears.students: Carry enrolled students into matching classes
academicYears.selectSourceHint: Choose a source year to enable import options.
academicYears.studentHint: Students keep their accounts and prior-year grades; only their current year and matching class are updated.
academicYears.activateNow: Make this the active academic year for all levels now
academicYears.safetyNote: Grade results, approvals, submissions, audit logs, and notifications are kept in the previous year and are never copied.
academicYears.invalidYear: Enter the new year as YYYY-YYYY.
academicYears.createFailed: Unable to create the academic year.
academicYears.mappingsDescription: Choose the active year for each educational level. This controls the year used by the student, teacher, and grade-management services.
